message.content:
### **1. Element Analysis (Position, Size, Color)**  
- **Header**:  
  - Logo: "U NILOV CATERIN" (left, 18px, gold #D4AF37).  
  - Navigation: 7 items (e.g., "ОФОРМАТЫ", "МЕНЮ") in 14px white, spaced 30px apart.  
  - Phone: "+7 (812) 919-59-11" (right, 14px gold).  
  - Highlight: "ОФОРМАТЫ" has a gold underline (2px, 30px wide) – inconsistent with other nav items.  

- **Menu Section**:  
  - Title: "МЕНЮ" (center, 24px gold, 40px top margin).  
  - Menu Items: 5 dark gray cards (240px wide × 80px tall) in a 4+1 grid.  
    - Text: 14px white, 16px line height, 20px left padding.  
  - Subtitle: "Это пример меню..." (center, 12px gray, 24px top margin).  
  - Button: "ПОЛНОЕ МЕНЮ" (center, 14px white, 40px × 40px, dark gray background).  

- **How It Works Section**:  
  - Title: "Как заказать" (center, 36px gold, 60px top margin).  
  - Subtitle: "Четыре простых шага..." (center, 14px gray, 16px top margin).  
  - Steps: 4 dark gray cards (240px wide × 200px tall) in a row.  
    - Step Numbers: "01"–"04" (24px gold, top-aligned).  
    - Step Titles: "Заявка"–"Мероприятие" (16px white, centered).  
    - Descriptions: 12px gray, 16px line height, 20px left/right padding.  

- **Floating Elements**:  
  - WhatsApp Icon: Green circle (bottom right, 40px diameter, 20px from edge).  
  - Logo: "N" (bottom left, 24px, black background).  


### **2. What Looks WRONG**  
- **Alignment**:  
  - Menu cards are left-aligned (not centered), creating visual imbalance.  
  - "How It Works" step cards are evenly spaced but lack vertical alignment with the title.  

- **Spacing**:  
  - Menu section: 40px top margin (too tight for a premium layout).  
  - "How It Works" subtitle: 16px top margin (too close to the title).  
  - Button: 40px × 40px (too small, looks like a secondary action).  

- **Contrast**:  
  - Menu card background: #1E1E1E (too dark, text feels "stuck").  
  - Step card descriptions: 12px gray (#666) on #1E1E1E (low contrast, hard to read).  

- **Ugly Elements**:  
  - Gold underline on "ОФОРМАТЫ": Inconsistent (no underline on other nav items), looks amateur.  
  - Menu card borders: 1px solid #333 (subtle but unnecessary, adds clutter).  


### **3. What Looks CHEAP vs PREMIUM**  
- **Cheap**:  
  - Uniform dark gray cards (no hierarchy, feels generic).  
  - Small button size (40px × 40px – looks like a "submit" button, not a premium CTA).  
  - Low-contrast text (hard to read, unprofessional).  
  - Floating "N" logo (unbranded, out of place).  

- **Premium**:  
  - Gold logo/text (adds luxury, but needs refinement).  
  - Dark background (sophisticated, but needs better contrast).  


### **4. 2026-Level Premium Changes**  
#### **Menu Presentation**  
- **Card Design**:  
  - Replace dark gray cards with **gradient backgrounds** (e.g., #2A2A2A → #1A1A1A) for depth.  
  - Add **1px gold borders** to cards (subtle, premium).  
  - Increase card size to **280px × 100px** (more breathing room).  
  - Add **hover effects**: Scale 1.02, gold border highlight.  

- **Typography**:  
  - Menu title: 32px gold (bold, 48px top margin).  
  - Menu item text: 16px white (bold, 20px padding).  
  - Subtitle: 14px gray (#888, 32px top margin).  

- **Button**:  
  - "ПОЛНОЕ МЕНЮ": 16px white, 50px × 50px, gold background (rounded corners: 8px).  
  - Add **icon** (e.g., arrow right) for visual hierarchy.  

#### **How It Works Steps**  
- **Card Design**:  
  - Gradient backgrounds (same as menu cards) with **gold step numbers** (bold, 28px).  
  - Step titles: 18px white (bold, centered).  
  - Descriptions: 14px gray (#999, 24px padding).  

- **Spacing**:  
  - Title: 80px top margin (generous, premium).  
  - Subtitle: 24px top margin (clear separation).  
  - Step cards: 40px gap (consistent, balanced).  

- **Alignment**:  
  - Center step cards (not left-aligned) for symmetry.  

#### **General Refinements**  
- **Navigation**:  
  - Remove gold underline; use **active state** (gold text, 2px bottom border) for consistency.  
  - Increase nav item spacing to 40px (cleaner, premium).  

- **Contrast**:  
  - Step descriptions: 14px gray (#999) on #1E1E1E (meets WCAG 4.5:1 contrast).  

- **Floating Elements**:  
  - Replace "N" logo with **brand icon** (e.g., gold "N" on black, 32px).  
  - WhatsApp icon: 50px diameter, 30px from edge (more prominent, premium).  

- **Section Transitions**:  
  - Add **subtle divider** (1px gold line) between menu and "How It Works" (clear separation).  


### **Pixel-Level Observations**  
- Menu cards: 280px × 100px (instead of 240px × 80px).  
- Button: 50px × 50px (instead of 40px × 40px).  
- Step numbers: 28px (instead of 24px).  
- Title margins: 80px (instead of 40px/60px).  
- Card borders: 1px gold (instead of 1px #333).  

These changes will elevate the design to a 2026 premium standard, focusing on hierarchy, contrast, and luxurious details.
